decks.notes: The deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan by utilizing a mixture of hand disruption, removal spells, and graveyard hate. The creatures in the deck have strong synergies with each other, allowing for powerful interactions that can quickly close out the game. The strategy involves applying pressure early on, while also controlling the board and limiting your opponent's resources. This deck is designed to attack from multiple angles, making it difficult for opponents to mount a defense against its aggressive and disruptive threats.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul and World Breaker, to control the game. It also includes various control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and powerful abilities, while also having access to cards like Karn, the Great Creator for additional utility and disruption. The combination of ramp, control, and Eldrazi threats makes this deck a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 play.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck utilizes strong creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer, Ragavan, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to apply pressure early on. Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment provide disruption and removal options to control the board. Showdown of the Skalds and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah offer ways to pump up the team and finish off opponents quickly. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on cycling through cards to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, and then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. The creatures in the deck have various abilities that can help control the board or disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes counterspells and removal spells to protect the combo and handle threats. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to efficiently cycle through cards, set up the Living End combo, and overwhelm the opponent with a board full of creatures.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, the deck can constantly apply pressure and keep opponents on their toes. Additionally, cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge provide additional reach and removal options. The deck also includes cards like Thraben Charm and Static Prison to disrupt opponents' strategies and slow them down. Overall, this deck aims to maintain a fast pace and outpace opponents with its aggressive threats.

The deck focuses on aggressive play using creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer, Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Guide of Souls alongside burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to quickly bring down the opponent's life total. It also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride to boost the team's power. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures, burn spells, and combat tricks while controlling the board with cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Underworld Breach, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Grinding Station to repeatedly mill both players' libraries and generate mana. This allows the player to cast spells from their graveyard and eventually win with a Grapeshot or Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also includes various artifacts and cheap spells to enable the combo faster, with Misty Rainforest and Urza's Saga providing additional utility. Additionally, disruptive elements like Unholy Heat and Spell Pierce help protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Blade of the Bloodchief, Basking Broodscale, and Glaring Fleshraker to create a lethal board state. The goal is to quickly ramp up mana with ramp spells like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple, while using Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board. Boseiju, Who Endures can protect key combo pieces from counterspells, and Emrakul, the Promised End offers a game-ending threat. The deck also includes versatile cards like Vexing Bauble and Traverse the Ulvenwald for additional consistency and utility.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through spells like Manamorphose and rituals, while also using card draw and selection like Gifts Ungiven and Preordain to set up the perfect combo. The goal is to eventually cast a storm spell like Grapeshot or Flame of Anor multiple times in a turn to overwhelm the opponent with damage. Cards like Baral, Chief of Compliance and Ral, Monsoon Mage help reduce the cost of spells and provide additional value to the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to mill through the deck quickly and find key combo pieces, such as Thassa's Oracle, Mishra's Bauble, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. By repeatedly playing cards from the graveyard with Underworld Breach and utilizing artifacts like Grinding Station and Mox Opal, the deck aims to empty the library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle's ability. Additional disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Soul-Guide Lantern help protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to create a loop where you can mill your deck, generate mana, and cast spells from your graveyard repeatedly. The goal is to generate enough mana and cards to eventually cast a lethal Grapeshot or Malevolent Rumble to win the game. Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal help with card selection and ramp, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student can tutor for key pieces. The deck also includes interaction with removal spells and counterspells to protect the combo.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures with blink effects to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp with powerful creatures like Ketramose and Phelia, the deck can generate value and pressure opponents quickly. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending allows the deck to handle threats efficiently while maintaining a strong board presence. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and disruptive plays to secure a quick victory.

The core idea of this Aggro-Death's Shadow deck is to quickly lower your own life total in order to make Death's Shadow and Nethergoyf incredibly powerful early threats. Thoughtseize and Surgical Extraction help disrupt your opponent's game plan, while cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Detective's Phoenix provide additional aggression and card advantage. The deck includes a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to control the board. The goal is to pressure the opponent while also disrupting their strategy, ultimately overwhelming them with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that have the ability to blink, allowing them to temporarily leave the battlefield and return with additional benefits. By utilizing cards that can flicker or blink creatures like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can disrupt opponent's strategies and provide value by reusing enter-the-battlefield effects. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude to handle threats, along with utility creatures like Recruiter of the Guard to search for key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and disruptive tactics.

The deck focuses on filling up the graveyard quickly to take advantage of cards like Vengevine and Detective's Phoenix, while using cards like Burning Inquiry and Goblin Lore to quickly cycle through the deck. Hollow One serves as a powerful early-game threat that can come into play for free with the right conditions. The deck aims to pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, while maintaining card advantage through looting effects. It aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize or outvalue the deck.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells and Eldrazi creatures to control the game, eventually casting powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Karn, the Great Creator. By using cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Return to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its efficient ramp and large threats. The inclusion of cards like Devourer of Destiny and Writhing Chrysalis also provide additional value and ways to apply pressure on the opponent.
